title: Tech in the 417: Findings from the Regional Workplace Survey
seo_title: Tech in the 417: Regional Workplace Survey Results
description: This is an informational presentation of the results of the 2026 Regional Workplace Survey, presented by Jack Henry and hosted by Springfield Women in Technology. It shares data from tech workers of all backgrounds and experience levels, covering workplace trends such as compensation, company culture, and remote and hybrid work in the Ozarks, and it brings together local professionals, community leaders, and advocates. It takes place Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 5:30 PM at The eFactory, 405 N Jefferson Ave in Springfield, MO.
venue: The eFactory (Robert W Plaster Free Enterprise Center)
